text:
Anya: Quick design check — compact error drilldown: should we surface inline actions (copy id, export, open in trace) next to each request row, or hide under a kebab to reduce visual noise? mock: https://img.redwood/mock/drilldown-compact-3.png
Mike: I like inline for power users. copy id & open in trace as icon buttons, export behind kebab. keeps common actions visible.
Rachel: Agree but worried about cramped rows on small screens. If inline, we need responsive collapse into kebab at <=880px. also copy tooltip needs to be accessible.
Simon: +1 on responsive collapse. Also: keyboard focus order — actions should be after the row content, not before. users expect to tab through details then actions.
Anya: good call. what about label/tooltip copy for screen readers? currently icons only have title attr.
design-bot: Accessibility check: icons must have aria-labels; avoid relying on title. Suggested labels: 
```
<button aria-label="Copy correlation id">📋</button>
<button aria-label="Open request in trace viewer">🔎</button>
<button aria-label="Export request as HAR">⬇️</button>
```
Rachel: tiny copy tweak: use "Copy correlation ID" (ID capitalized) and "Open in Trace Viewer" to match product naming.
Mike: Also consider an inline confirmation for copy — small toast anchored to row. Keep it subtle.
Anya: UX question: should exported filename include correlation id? e.g., request-<corrid>.har — helps users correlate downloads.
Simon: yes, include corrid. And include 1s debounce on export button to avoid double clicks.
Anya: layout idea: compact row height 40px, action icons 20px, 8px gap. When collapsed to kebab, keep the kebab visually consistent with rest of the table actions.
Rachel: a11y nit: keyboard-only users need visible focus ring on icons in high-contrast mode. add outline: 2px solid #005fcc on :focus-visible.
Mike: perf nit: rendering a ton of icon buttons in large tables hurts paint. consider rendering actions lazily on hover/focus or using a single interactive cell that expands to actions.
Anya: decision proposal: show two icons inline (Copy, Open) and kebab for secondary (Export, Share, Annotate). responsive collapse at 880px -> all actions under kebab. keyboard focus order: row content -> Copy -> Open -> kebab. accessibility: explicit aria-labels, focus-visible style, toast confirmation for copy.
Rachel: LGTM. add a visual affordance for "open" icon to indicate it opens new view (external icon) — add sr-only text "opens in trace viewer" for screen readers.
Simon: I'll prototype the keyboard flow and add a small perf test for large tables.
Anya: thanks — can someone add these to the epic ticket? /cc @Mike for copy changes. Action items:
- Mike: PR with copy tweaks and aria-label list (due EOD)
- Simon: keyboard-flow prototype + perf baseline (due Tue)
- Rachel: add focus-visible spec to design tokens + responsive breakpoint (due Mon)
- Anya: update mocks and put final decision in Figma and ticket
Mike: on it :+1:
